wins.label: Q4 beat across metrics
wins.evidence: Revenue, gross margin and EPS were all above our guidance

wins.label: Strong AI-driven demand
wins.evidence: AI PC units grew 16%, DCAI was up 15%, reflecting strong demand for traditional server compute

wins.label: Core Ultra Series 3 momentum
wins.evidence: Delivered 3 SKUs ahead of expectations, powering over 200 notebook designs with up to 27 hours battery life

wins.label: Custom ASIC business growth
wins.evidence: Custom ASIC business grew more than 50% in 2025, 26% sequentially and reached an annualized revenue run rate greater than $1 billion in Q4

wins.label: Advanced packaging opportunities
wins.evidence: Early customer engagements suggest opportunities well north of $1 billion on advanced packaging, way more exciting than expected

risks.label: Supply constraints limiting growth
risks.evidence: Revenue would have been meaningfully higher if we had more supply; supply constraints are most acute in Q1

risks.label: Yields below target
risks.evidence: While yields are in line with our internal plans, they are still below what I want them to be

risks.label: Q1 2026 revenue decline
risks.evidence: Forecasting Q1 revenue range of $11.7 billion to $12.7 billion, at the lower end of seasonal Q1

risks.label: Gross margin pressure
risks.evidence: Gross margin down sequentially due to lower revenue, increased 18A volumes and product mix; 34.5% is by no means an acceptable level

risks.label: Component pricing headwinds
risks.evidence: Industry-wide supply for key components like DRAM, NAND and substrates has come under increasing pressure; rising component pricing could limit revenue opportunity
